title: Existence and stability of weak critical points of $r$-energy functionals
summary: The main aim of this paper is to prove the existence of certain proper weakly $r$-harmonic ($ES-r$-harmonic) maps. We construct critical points which belong to a family of rotationally symmetric maps $\varphi_a : B^n \to \mathbb{S}^n$, where $B^n$ and $\mathbb{S}^n$ denote the Euclidean $n$-dimensional unit ball and sphere respectively. We find that the existence of solutions within this family is restricted to specific dimensions $n$. Next, we prove that our critical points are \textit{unstable}.
